events.title: Is Boeing's Growing Backlog Strengthening Its Recovery Prospects?
events.body: BA's record $695B backlog, rising aircraft deliveries and defense growth signal improving operations and stronger revenue visibility.

events.title: Lockheed Martin’s New Defense Wins Deepen Long Term Revenue Visibility
events.body: Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) has been named preferred combat systems integrator for Australia’s Virginia-class submarine fleet under the AUKUS program. The company received a US$879 million Pentagon contract related to F-35 aircraft armament

events.title: Cathie Wood Shifts ARK's Defense Stocks; Contracts, Foreign Sales In Focus
events.body: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest loads up on defense, air taxi stocks. Navy awards contracts to Lockheed, Northrop. U.S. announces foreign military sales.
